title: Multiscale spatial atlas of human basal ganglia cell types and communities
title_zh: 人类基底神经节细胞类型与群落的多尺度空间图谱
abstract: The human basal ganglia comprise functionally varied nuclei, but their cell-type composition and spatial organization have not been comprehensively resolved. We generated a multi-region, subcellular-resolution spatial transcriptomic atlas by integrating multiplexed error-robust fluorescence in situ hybridization (MERFISH)+ and spatiotemporal enhanced-resolution omics sequencing (Stereo-seq) across four neurotypical donors. The datasets profiled ∼7.9 million cells across the caudate, putamen, nucleus accumbens, and globus pallidus, resolving 60 transcriptionally distinct cell types. We identify region-selective molecular and spatial diversification of spiny projection neurons and non-neuronal populations. Subcellular RNA localization captures somatic size and projection-inferred signatures, reflecting direct- and indirect-pathway topology. Cellular community analyses reveal astrocyte and oligodendrocyte subclusters enriched at striosome-matrix borders, while primate-expanded interneurons are confined to matrix territories. Cross-species comparisons reveal conserved and species-specialized organization, including orthologous striosome-matrix architecture and conserved dorsolateral-to-ventromedial transcriptional gradients. Together, this multi-centimeter-scale human basal ganglia atlas links cell types, spatial architecture, and subcellular transcript topography across scales.
abstract_zh: 人类基底神经节包含功能各异的核团，但其细胞类型组成和空间组织尚未得到全面阐明。我们通过整合多重错误稳健荧光原位杂交（MERFISH）与时空增强分辨率组学测序（Stereo-seq），在四名神经典型供体的多个脑区构建了亚细胞分辨率的空间转录组图谱。该数据集对尾状核、壳核、伏隔核和苍白球中约790万个细胞进行了分析，鉴定出60种转录上不同的细胞类型。我们发现棘射射射神经元和非神经元细胞群呈现区域特异性的分子与空间多样化。亚细胞RNA定位捕捉了胞体大小及投影推断的特征，反映了直接通路与间接通路的拓扑。细胞群落分析显示，星形胶质细胞和少突胶质细胞亚簇富集于条纹体—基质边界，而灵长类扩展的中间神经元则局限于基质区域。跨物种比较揭示了保守的与物种特异的组织，包括同源的条纹体—基质结构和保守的背外侧到腹内侧转录梯度。因此，这个跨厘米尺度的人类基底神经节图谱在多个尺度上连接了细胞类型、空间结构与亚细胞转录组地形。
